sections.title: Lifecycle, identity, privacy, legal boundaries and interoperability
Security, conformance, scenarios and design recommendations
Evidence ledger, adoption, bibliography and limits

method: Full sequential reading of every supplied line via five untruncated sed outputs, followed by semantic extraction and schema checks. No external source acquisition or verification.

token_usage.note: Host actual usage unavailable; graph zeros are schema placeholders, not measured usage.

limitations: EXTRACTED denotes an explicit relationship in the supplied report, not independently verified truth.
The report citation markers are opaque and were not resolved to primary sources.
Sandbox-linked CSV and JSON companion catalogs were not supplied/read.
Report date and standards/audit/legal/adoption status claims were not independently refreshed.
Cardano mixed-policy, unfracking, cost amplification and third-party concerns remain contested report-level assurance questions, not confirmed vulnerabilities.
No empirical tests, formal correspondence, asset implementation, or production acceptance were performed.
